name: Syr Vondam
description: Syr Vondam is a Solar Knight of the Sunstar Free Company, mentor of the squire Haliya and an old friend of Captain Slats.

summary.text: Syr Vondam is a Solar Knight of the Sunstar Free Company, mentor of the squire Haliya and an old friend of Captain Slats.

bio.text: Captain Slats phorocast that Vondam would die in the battle at the Dawnsire, and Vondam closed his helmet, told Haliya to look to the Sum, and went to face the attack.

citations.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 3" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Jun 2025.
"Edge of Eternities | Episode 3" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Jun 2025.

bio.text: He blasted Simma off course and offered the unarmored Alpharael mercy, but a newborn microvoid passed through his head and he toppled.

citations.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 4" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Jun 2025.
"Edge of Eternities | Episode 4" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Jun 2025.
"Edge of Eternities | Episode 4" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Jun 2025.

bio.text: He was revealed alive with a pinhead hole through his head, suspected his survival was engineered, and vowed to pursue Alpharael.

citations.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 4" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Jun 2025.
"Edge of Eternities | Episode 4" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Jun 2025.
"Edge of Eternities | Episode 4" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Jun 2025.

bio.text: He declared his judgment untrustworthy, let Haliya go to Taro-duend in his place, and then announced protocol seven, which led to the massacre there.

citations.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 7" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Jul 2025.
"Edge of Eternities | Episode 7" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Jul 2025.
"Edge of Eternities | Episode 8" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Jul 2025.

bio.text: He refused to destroy the ship while Haliya begged him to order her death, and later in Pinnacle custody he warned Mantis that both sides would blockade the eternity column.

citations.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 8" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Jul 2025.
"Edge of Eternities | Episode 8" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Jul 2025.
"Edge of Eternities | Episode 9" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Jul 2025.

bio.text: On Infinite Guideline he called Haliya home, but she refused, and he degraded her and cast her out of the Free Company.

citations.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 10" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Jul 2025.
"Edge of Eternities | Episode 11" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jul 2025.
"Edge of Eternities | Episode 11" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jul 2025.

bio.text: Haliya cut his nerve interface in a duel, leaving him helpless, and he demanded that she kill him, but she could not.

citations.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 11" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jul 2025.
"Edge of Eternities | Episode 11" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jul 2025.

status.text: As of the latest story, Vondam is alive but crippled by Haliya, who left him helpless on Infinite Guideline.

citations.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 11" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jul 2025.
"Edge of Eternities | Episode 11" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Shot during the attack, Alpharael throws the singularity bead, destroying Vondam's head and his own hand; a timeline revision by the Endstone leaves only holes, and Captain Slats lets him escape.
timeline.quote: After being shot by a bladiator in the attack, Alpharael realized that he didn't want to die.

citation.text: "Alpharael", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Pursued by Vondam, Alpharael is shot down in the debris field of Kavaron and rescued by Sami and Tannuk.
timeline.quote: Alpharael was shot down and crashed in the debris field of Kavaron

citation.text: "Alpharael", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Haliya tries to force Alpharael to alter the past; Vondam slaughters the Kav citizens, convincing Haliya the Summists were wrong, and the crew escapes.
timeline.quote: Vondam refused to hurt Haliya and opened fire on the Kav citizens instead, slaughtering them all.

citation.text: "Alpharael", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Alpharael and Haliya duel Vondam together and win; the crew warps to the Wurmwall, where the Vaar take the Endstone.
timeline.quote: the Endstone was taken away by the Vaar

citation.text: "Alpharael", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Monoists attack the Dawnsire; Slats prophesies Vondam's death and Alpharael throws the bead through his head, apparently killing him.
timeline.quote: it went directly through Syr Vondam's head, apparently killing him

citation.text: "Vondam", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After the Endstone's timeline revision Vondam survives with a hole in his head and vows to pursue Alpharael.
timeline.quote: Vondam survived

citation.text: "Vondam", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Vondam deduces the Endstone manipulated events to draw Alpharael to it.
timeline.quote: it was his burden and doom to deliver the object to his superiors

citation.text: "Vondam", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Vondam and Haliya track Alpharael to Kavaron; after Haliya fails he orders the massacre of Taro-duend and surrenders.
timeline.quote: he enacted protocol seven, ordering the massacre of all 6,000 inhabitants of Taro-duend

citation.text: "Vondam", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Vondam fights Haliya and Alpharael and is disabled, begging to be finished; they leave.
timeline.quote: Haliya separated the vertebrae in Vondam's neck

citation.text: "Vondam", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: On the Candela, Haliya wraps Vondam in his himsary banners before battle and he tells her they go to the Dawnsire where there may be combat.
timeline.quote: We are going over to the Dawnsire today,

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 3" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: Haliya recites the Litany of Dawn with Vondam and asks for breakfast with her friends.
timeline.quote: If it is where you want to be when you face death, Squire? Then there is time for nothing else.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 3" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: Vondam and Haliya go to the Dawnsire's bridge and meet Captain Slats, an Astelli, who phorocasts that Vondam will die in the battle.
timeline.quote: I phorocast that you die in the battle.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 3" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: Haliya blurts that the prophecy might be an enemy trick, uttering the blasphemy anstruth.
timeline.quote: "Anstruth, Syr," she says.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 3" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: The bridge darkens red as phorocast detects an imminent impact, and Slats orders collision alarms and the deployment of knights.
timeline.quote: Garrison to repel boarders, number-two basilica!

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 3" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: Vondam closes his helmet and tells Haliya to look to the Sum, then goes to face the attack.
timeline.quote: Look to the Sum, Squire.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 3" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: Squire Haliya follows Syr Vondam down the Dawnsire's spine, convinced she will die.
timeline.quote: They plunge down the Dawnsire 's spine.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 4" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: Haliya fears for Vondam, who is prophesied to die, and resolves to die before him.
timeline.quote: Vondam is prophesied to die.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 4" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: Vondam, Walker and Quinidad learn from a phonon survey that Sunstar garrison troops are fighting the boarders near the basilica.
timeline.quote: A company of the garrison has engaged boarders just abeam of the basilica.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 4" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: Vondam and Walker fire their bladiators through the deck to strike the Monoists below, with Haliya cleaning Vondam's beamline.
timeline.quote: The two knights plunge their bladiators into the deck and fire .

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 4" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: The Monoists below pulse gravity waves at the deck, shaking it apart.
timeline.quote: The deck whines under their boots.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 4" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: As she falls, Haliya broadcasts all her power to protect Vondam.
timeline.quote: She throws her arms out to her knight and broadcasts every bit of power she can.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 4" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: Haliya's blade splits Alpharael open and his armor fails, and a Sunstar knight's beam throws him into a corner.
timeline.quote: The Summist's blade splits him open.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 4" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: Vondam arrives, drives Alpharael off Haliya, and orders a concussion drill.
timeline.quote: Haliya! Concussion drill!

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 4" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: Vondam accepts Alpharael's challenge, naming himself of the Sunstar Free Company.
timeline.quote: I am Syr Vondam of the Sunstar Free Company.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 4" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: Simma pounces from the steam to slap a mine on Vondam's helm.
timeline.quote: Old Simma pounces.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 4" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: Vondam blasts Simma off course with a pulse of sunfire.
timeline.quote: The knight twists the pulse of sunfire down a magnetic field and blasts Simma askew.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 4" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: Vondam kills the main enemy, apparently Simma, and Haliya fights to hold Alpharael back.
timeline.quote: Vondam has killed the main enemy.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 4" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: Vondam offers the now unarmored Alpharael mercy, urging him to choose life.
timeline.quote: Come, then! Choose life!

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 4" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: The newborn microvoid passes through Syr Vondam's head.
timeline.quote: Along the way, it goes directly through Syr Vondam's head .

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 4" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: Alpharael watches in disbelief as Vondam topples and decides to flee.
timeline.quote: Alpharael stares in giddy disbelief as Syr Vondam, Solar Knight of the Free Company, topples like a drunk.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 4" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: Slats tells Alpharael he foresaw him killing his friend and asks why.
timeline.quote: You struck dead a man who was my friend. I foresaw this. I want to know why.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 4" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: Haliya despairs over Vondam's apparent death and her failure to save him.
timeline.quote: The Haliya who wasn't quick, or strong, or sure enough to save her knight, the Haliya who allowed a pathetic fallen foe to throw his suicide through Vondam's skull .

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 4" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: Vondam is revealed alive, with a pinhead hole through his head.
timeline.quote: He shows Haliya the hole in his helmet, then the hole in his face, just to the left of his nose.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 4" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: Slats says Vondam died but was not dead.
timeline.quote: You died, but you were not dead.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 4" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: Haliya reveals that Captain Slats let Alpharael escape in a Hopelight.
timeline.quote: "Captain Slats let him."

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 4" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: Vondam suspects the event of his survival was engineered and that he is an anstruth.
timeline.quote: I am also an anstruth.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 4" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: Vondam concludes some force wants Alpharael alive.
timeline.quote: I'm saying that something wants that Monoist alive.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 4" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: Vondam vows that he and Haliya will pursue Alpharael once healed.
timeline.quote: But once we're fit again, we're going after him.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 4" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: Haliya, aboard the Sundog, stares guiltily at the hole in Vondam's skull and thinks of Alpharael.
timeline.quote: Haliya catches herself staring at the hole in Syr Vondam's skull again.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 7" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Vondam and Haliya left the Dawnsire in a secret rush, telling no one, not even Captain Slats.
timeline.quote: They left the Dawnsire in a secret rush, telling no one, not even Captain Slats.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 7" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Vondam says they are going to find and kill Alpharael, not for revenge.
timeline.quote: All he will say is that they are going to find and kill Alpharael.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 7" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Vondam orders the Sundog to repeat its demand that Taro-duend hand over the spy and to launch Hopelights for surveillance.
timeline.quote: Give them another chance to hand over the spy. Launch the Hopelights.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 7" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Vondam gives Haliya a quartz crystal containing the anathalmanac.
timeline.quote: He gives her a quartz memory crystal.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 7" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Vondam explains his belief that an anathema object in Sothera is calling for a wielder and threatens the Sunstar mission.
timeline.quote: I believe one such object is in Sothera.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 7" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Vondam says the object manipulated Slats's vision, Vondam's death and survival to draw Alpharael to it.
timeline.quote: The object manipulated everything.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 7" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Vondam declares that his judgment cannot be trusted and Haliya is now effectively the knight.
timeline.quote: In a sense, Haliya, you are now the knight and I the squire.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 7" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Vondam asks Haliya whether she could order the destruction of all Taro-duend if needed.
timeline.quote: Can you destroy it all?

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 7" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Haliya refuses to help kill a settlement of innocents.
timeline.quote: I won't do it. I'm not going to kill a settlement full of defenseless innocents.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 7" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Haliya proposes to go down to Taro-duend herself to find and kill Alpharael.
timeline.quote: You don't go down there. I do.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 7" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Haliya persuades Vondam to let her go in his place by invoking a knight's trust.
timeline.quote: He would give her a chance to be worthy of his trust.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 7" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Haliya asks Alpharael to use the object to change the past so she was the one he killed, sparing Vondam.
timeline.quote: I need you to change things so that I was the one you killed

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 7" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Haliya tells Vondam she has Alpharael and offers to be the one the object changed.
timeline.quote: I can be the one it changed. You can be yourself again.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 7" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Vondam orders Haliya to kill Alpharael and return with the object.
timeline.quote: Haliya, I am ordering you to kill him and return with the object.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 7" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Haliya tells Vondam to proceed with protocol seven and fire on her, the object and the Kav.
timeline.quote: You have to fire. Destroy me, the object, and the Kav.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 7" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Vondam orders Haliya to get out and move to the slag field for extraction.
timeline.quote: Move to the slag field for extraction.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 7" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Vondam announces to all units that they are going to protocol seven and have two minutes.
timeline.quote: We are going to protocol seven. You have two minutes.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 8" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Haliya demands the ship land and puts herself on the distress frequency so Vondam will hear.
timeline.quote: Land this ship. Put me on one-forty-two.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 8" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Haliya radios Vondam, claiming she has the object and urging him to stop killing the Kav.
timeline.quote: Syr Vondam. Syr Vondam, this is Squire Haliya.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 8" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Vondam tells Haliya to kill the crew and force the ship down.
timeline.quote: We'll keep pace until you can kill the crew and force it down.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 8" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Haliya urges Vondam to order her death as protocol seven requires.
timeline.quote: We traded places. Now you must order mine!

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 8" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Vondam refuses to destroy the ship, wanting the object retrieved in stasis.
timeline.quote: We'll retrieve the object and return it to Candela in stasis.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 8" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Haliya begs Vondam to kill her too if the object is worth so much.
timeline.quote: Syr, kill me. If this object is worth so much.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 8" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Haliya and Alpharael explain to Sami how they came to Kavaron.
timeline.quote: Together the two of them explain to Captain Sami how they came to Kavaron.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 8" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Haliya concludes that Vondam obeyed the Sum but that the massacre was nonetheless wrong.
timeline.quote: But it was wrong. I know it.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 8" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Vondam, in Pinnacle custody, is questioned by Mantis.
timeline.quote: He surrendered his ship to the Kav, without contest, on the condition that he be delivered directly to Infinite Guideline and Pinnacle custody.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 9" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Vondam warns that both sides will blockade the eternity column.
timeline.quote: That they must blockade the eternity column and prevent any ship from escaping Sothera.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 9" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Vondam tells Mantis an artifact is present in Sothera that the enemy cannot obtain.
timeline.quote: We have discovered that there is an artifact present in Sothera which we cannot permit the enemy to obtain.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 9" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Vondam describes an unstable double stalemate as both fleets move toward Infinite Guideline.
timeline.quote: We are in an unstable double stalemate.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 9" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Mantis asks whether Vondam would destroy the station to stop the artifact, and he says yes.
timeline.quote: Would you destroy this station and the eternity column, trapping yourself in Sothera, in order to prevent the artifact from escaping?

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 9" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Vondam predicts his former student will come to Infinite Guideline to steal an eternity drive.
timeline.quote: Infinite Guideline has an eternity column, and it is the only place in the system with eternity drive ferries that can lift her ship into warp.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 9" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Haliya agrees to send the message, saying she will carry out her duty to report to Vondam and beg pardon for Alpharael.
timeline.quote: All I can do is carry out my next duty. To return to Vondam, make my report, and beg pardon for Alpharael.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 9" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Haliya says she will not become someone who kills innocents in their homes.
timeline.quote: I don't want to be someone who kills innocents in their homes.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 9" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Haliya broadcasts to the Free Company that she has detached from Vondam's command and offers the artifact on Infinite Guideline.
timeline.quote: I have detached myself from Syr Vondam's command and placed myself on errantry.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 10" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Mantis reveals Vondam came to confess and warn Pinnacle about the battle over the Endstone.
timeline.quote: Syr Vondam came to us to confess his crimes and warn us to evacuate Infinite Guideline .

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 10" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Mantis admits Vondam persuaded her lethal force might be justified but she has not used it.
timeline.quote: Checkmate Mantis draws a long, low drone from her legs. "Yes."

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 10" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Vondam appears on the control deck and says he acted in accordance with the Sum except when he let Haliya go out of love.
timeline.quote: I did act in accordance with the Sum. Except when I let you go. I did that out of love.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 10" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Vondam, helmet open and bladiators ready, stands between them and the airlock.
timeline.quote: He is here. Standing on the far side of the control deck. Between them and the airlock.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 10" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Vondam calls on Haliya to come home and take the Endstone.
timeline.quote: Come home, Haliya.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 10" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Vondam tells Haliya he should have killed her when she begged him to and urges her to live with failure.
timeline.quote: I should've killed you when you begged me to.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 11" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Vondam cuts the boots off Alpharael's armor.
timeline.quote: Alpharael tries to move and Vondam, without looking, cuts the bulky, elevated boots of his suit off.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 11" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Vondam pleads with Haliya to return to the faith.
timeline.quote: "Come back," he pleads.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 11" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Haliya refuses to return home with the stone as a hero and explains the Sum must account for her revolt.
timeline.quote: I will not go home with the stone and be a hero.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 11" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Haliya drives Vondam off Alpharael with her bladiator.
timeline.quote: She thrusts her long-handled bladiator from the hip and drives Syr Vondam off.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 11" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Vondam formally degrades Haliya and bars her from knighthood.
timeline.quote: by my authority as a knight of the company, I hereby degrade you.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 11" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Haliya is cast out of the Free Company and chooses to believe her choice was right.
timeline.quote: He has cast her out of the Free Company.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 11" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Haliya and Vondam fight a sparring-style duel on the control deck.
timeline.quote: "Tally-ho," Vondam says, mildly.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 11" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Vondam says protocol dictated the slaughter, convincing Haliya that the fault lies in the Sum.
timeline.quote: I had to. Protocol dictated it.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 11" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Haliya embraces Vondam and, using the hole in Alpharael's hand, jabs her thumb into the back of his neck.
timeline.quote: Haliya embraces him and jabs her right thumb into the hole in Alpharael's hand.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 11" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Haliya pops apart Vondam's vertebrae.
timeline.quote: She digs her thumb into his vertebrae and pops them apart.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 11" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Haliya cuts Vondam's nerve interface, leaving him helpless.
timeline.quote: But his squire reaches through the hole in her enemy's hand and cuts her knight's nerve interface away.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 11" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Haliya makes her report to Vondam and asks pardon for Alpharael.
timeline.quote: I have made my report,

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 11" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Vondam demands that Haliya kill him but she cannot do what the Sum asks.
timeline.quote: She cannot do what the Sum asks.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 11" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Haliya places herself on errantry, still a Summist but cast out of the Free Company.
timeline.quote: I've been cast out of the Free Company, but I am still a Summist. I place myself on errantry.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 11" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Haliya pledged her bladiator to Syr Vondam's service.
timeline.quote: Haliya has pledged her bladiator to the service of Syr Vondam, her mentor and idol who has trained her since she was a young woman.

citation.work: The Legends of Edge of Eternities
citation.text: "The Legends of Edge of Eternities" by Miguel Lopez, Amanda LaFranco, Laurel Pratt, Jay Annelli. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Vondam commands a knightly host assigned to defend the Dawnsire.
timeline.quote: Syr Vondam is a high-ranking knight of the Sunstar Free Company who commands a knightly host assigned to defend the Dawnsire .

citation.work: The Legends of Edge of Eternities
citation.text: "The Legends of Edge of Eternities" by Miguel Lopez, Amanda LaFranco, Laurel Pratt, Jay Annelli. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Vondam orders Kavaron's civilians killed instead of Haliya and the others, leading her to believe the Endstone cannot fall into the Summists' hands.
timeline.quote: Vondam ordered the innocent civilians of Kavaron to be killed instead of Haliya and the others on the ship

citation.text: "Endstone", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Solar Knights reignite the star of Haliya's frozen homeworld; she joins the Sunstar Free Company and becomes Vondam's squire.
timeline.quote: The Solar Knights arrived and reignited the star

citation.text: "Haliya", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Monoists attack the Dawnsire; Vondam and Haliya help lead the defense, and Slats prophesies Vondam's death.
timeline.quote: it was attacked by a strike cadre of Monoists

citation.text: "Haliya", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Alpharael throws away his singularity bead, which passes through Vondam's head without lethal damage.
timeline.quote: Along the way, it went directly through Syr Vondam's head, apparently killing him.

citation.text: "Haliya", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Vondam deduces the Endstone manipulated events and resolves to pursue Alpharael.
timeline.quote: he suspected that Alpharael would come in possession of a very dangerous object, the Endstone

citation.text: "Haliya", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At Infinite Guideline Station Vondam casts Haliya out of the Free Company; she subdues him.
timeline.quote: she was stopped by Syr Vondam, who cast her out of the Free Company

citation.text: "Haliya", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Palestar Sundog under Syr Vondam destroys Taro-duend, killing all 6,000 inhabitants and igniting its fusion engine in a nuclear blast.
timeline.quote: After killing all 6,000 inhabitants, the ship ignited its fusion engine, wiping out the remains in a nuclear blast.

citation.text: "Kavaron", section "Geography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: They rescue Alpharael, who is pursued by the Sunstar Free Company.
timeline.quote: rescuing him after his Hopelight warmaker crashed in the debris field
